blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 4D novel view synthesis (NVS) aims to render dynamic scenes across viewpoints and timestamps, which requires jointly inferring 3D structure and temporal dynamics. Existing monocular feed-forward methods often rely on explicit 4D Gaussian representations, which are prone to temporal inconsistency and severe rendering artifacts. We present FL4N, the first feed-forward latent 4D NVS model. Instead of relying on explicit 4D primitives, FL4N encodes a 4D scene prior into a unified latent representation across space and time. Our core insight is that learning temporal dynamics as residuals on top of a pretrained static latent prior enables effective 4D modeling with limited dynamic training data. To this end, we introduce a lightweight dynamic encoder that leverages static scene features to disentangle object motion from camera-induced parallax. Trained solely with an image synthesis objective, FL4N achieves state-of-the-art 4D NVS quality while rendering in real time. Its learned latent representation generalizes to real-world videos and disentangles viewpoint from time.
blocks.zh: 4D小说取景合成(NVS)旨在使动态场景跨越观点和时间戳,这需要共同推断出3D结构和时间动态. 现有的单向饲料前行法往往依赖于明确的4D高斯表示法,这些表示法容易出现时间不一致和严重渲染出文物. 我们提出FL4N, 第一个向前进的潜在4DNVS模型。 FL4N没有依赖明确的4D原始,而是将一个4D场景在之前编码成一个跨越空间和时间的统一潜伏的表示. 我们的核心见解是,在经过预先训练的静态潜伏之前,学习时间动态作为残余物,能够以有限的动态培训数据进行有效的4D模型。 为此,我们引入了一种轻量级动态编码器,利用静态场景特征将物体运动从相机所引发的抛物管中分离出来. FL4N完全以图像合成目标来训练,实现了最先进的4D NVS质量,同时实时渲染. 它所学的潜质表现概括到现实世界的视频,并且从时间上分散观点.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
4D novel view synthesis (NVS) is a cornerstone of understanding and simulating our ever-changing physical world, enabling broad applications, e. g . , immersive graphics ( Li et al., 2025 ) , world models ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , robotics ( Kim et al., 2026b ) , autonomous driving ( Song et al., 2025 ) , and 4D-aware vision-language models ( Cho et al., 2026 ) .
Unlike static NVS ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ) , 4D NVS requires capturing both persistent 3D structure and temporal dynamics.
While slow optimization-based methods ( Pumarola et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) and multi-view methods ( Xu et al., 2024b ; Balice et al., 2026 ) are impractical in the wild, monocular feed-forward approaches offer a practical, real-time solution by inferring a 4D scene from a casual video.
blocks.zh:
4D小说取景合成(NVS)是理解和模拟我们不断变化的物理世界的基石,能够实现广泛的应用,例如:活泼图形(李等,2025年),世界模型(朱等,2025年),机器人(金等,2026b),自主驱动(宋等,2025年),和4D-意识视觉语言模型. (Cho等,2026年).
与静态NVS不同(Jin等,2025;Hong等,2025),4D NVS要求既捕捉持久性的三维结构和时间动态.
缓慢优化方法 (Pumarola等,2021;Wang等,2025b)和多视角方法(徐等,2024b;Balice等,2026)在野外,单向饲料推进方法不切实际,通过从一段临时视频推断出一出4D场景,提供了实用而实时的解决办法.

blocks.en:
However, monocular feed-forward 4D NVS is highly ill-posed, as it must jointly infer entangled 3D structure and object motion from monocular observations alone ( Wang et al., 2025b ) .
This requires the model to learn a strong 4D prior.
To make this tractable, existing methods ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) rely on the explicit 3D inductive bias of 3D Gaussians ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) with added 3D motion and dense geometry and motion supervision.
However, this reliance on explicit 3D primitives often bottlenecks 4D rendering quality.
Inaccurate prediction of Gaussian attributes across timestamps often yields rendering artifacts, e. g . , temporal ghosting, floaters, and holes ( Kim et al., 2026c ; An et al., 2026 ) , as in Fig. 1 .
Moreover, time-varying effects ( e. g . , shadows and illumination changes) must be encoded in per-primitive attributes ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and regions with
insufficient primitive coverage tend to be over-smoothed ( Li et al., 2024 ; Kim et al., 2026c ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,单向饲料向前的4D NVS的投放率非常低,因为它必须共同推断单向观测中缠绕了3D结构和物体运动(Wang等,2025b). 。 。 。 。
这需要模型学习强的4D前作.
使这一现有方法具有可操作性(徐等,2025;林等,2026a; Yang et al., 2026 )依靠3D高斯人(Kerbl等,2023 )明显的3D诱导偏差,加上了3D运动和密集几何和运动监督.
然而,这种对显性3D原始的依赖往往会瓶颈出4D渲染质量.
对跨时间戳的高斯人属性的不准确预测往往会产生渲染文物,如:时间幽灵,活活人和孔(Kim等,2026c;An等,2026),如图一.
此外,时间变化效应(例如:阴影和光照变化)必须在每个原始属性(Li等,2024年)和具有下列特征的区域编码:
原始覆盖率不足往往过于平滑(Li等,2024;Kim等,2026c.).

blocks.en:
In recent static NVS literature, latent-based methods ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Szymanowicz et al., 2026 ; Mitchel et al., 2025 ) avoid these limitations by learning view synthesis end-to-end with transformers, mapping input views directly to target views conditioned on a target camera, without an explicit 3D representation.
With minimal 3D inductive biases and large-scale training, these latent models outperform 3D-Gaussian-based methods in visual fidelity ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026a ) .
However, directly extending the latent approach to dynamic scenes faces a fundamental challenge.
Without explicit 3D priors, learning to disentangle 3D structure and temporal dynamics purely
from data would require massive multi-view dynamic scene datasets ( Van Hoorick et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) , which are much scarcer than static datasets ( Watson et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
在最近的静态NVS文献中,潜伏方法(Jin等,2025;Szymanowicz等,2026;Mitchel等,2025)避免了这些局限性,方法是用变压器学习视星等合成端到端,将输入视图直接映射到以目标相机为条件的目标视图上,没有明确的3D表示.
这些潜在模型在3D-Gausian的视觉忠贞度上超过了3D-Gausian的方法(Jin等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026a年)。
然而,将潜在方法直接扩展到动态场景,面临着根本性的挑战。
没有明确的 三维前传, 学习分离 三维结构和时间动态纯粹
从数据来看,需要大量的多视图动态场景数据集(Van Hoorick等,2024年;Bai等,2025年),这些数据集比静态数据集少得多(Watson等,2025年)。

blocks.en:
To resolve this challenge, we propose FL4N , a F eed-forward L atent-based 4 D N VS model, which augments a frozen pretrained static latent NVS model with a trainable dynamic encoder.
Our key insight is that a 4D latent model does not need to learn dynamic scene representation from scratch: pretrained static latent NVS models already possess a strong, generalizable 3D prior, allowing the dynamic encoder to exclusively focus on modeling temporal changes ( e. g . , object motion or appearance variation).
Consequently, our method can be trained with a small amount of dynamic data while fully inheriting the pretrained model’s ability to synthesize coherent novel views.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这一挑战,我们提议FL4N,一种F eed-forward L entent-based 4 D N VS模型,该模型用可被训练的动态编码器来增强被冷冻的前置静态潜伏NVS模型.
我们的关键见解是,4D潜伏模型不需要从零开始学习动态场景表现:预受训练的静态潜伏NVS模型已经拥有了强而通俗的3D前,允许动态编码器专门专注于模型的时间变化(例如:物体运动或外观变异等).
因此,我们的方法可以用少量的动态数据来训练,同时完全继承预先训练过的模型综合一致的新观点的能力。

blocks.en:
Concretely, we attach the lightweight trainable dynamic encoder alongside the frozen static encoder, similar to ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) .
The dynamic encoder takes the same input views with a learnable per-view time token and cross-attends to frozen static encoder features to isolate true scene dynamics from camera-induced motion.
A lightweight time module then modulates the residual latent for the queried timestamp, which is residually added to the static latent ( He et al., 2016 ) and decoded by the frozen renderer at the target camera pose.
Multi-view videos naturally disentangle viewpoint and temporal variation through same-time views and fixed views across time. Sampling unseen view–time pairs, FL4N learns this disentanglement through image synthesis with binary dynamic mask supervision, without dense geometry or motion supervision.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,我们附加了可轻量级的可发动编码器与冷冻的静态编码器,类似于ControlNet(张等,2023年).
动态编码器采用相同的输入视图,并带有可学习的每处视图时间符和交叉对被冷冻的静态编码器特性,将真实的场景动态与相机所引发的运动相隔离.
轻量级时间模块再调节被询问时间戳的剩余潜在值,剩余值被添加到静态潜在值上(He等,2016年),由被冻结的渲染器在目标相机姿势上解码.
多取景视频自然会通过同时取景和不同时间的固定取景来分散观点和时间差异. FL4N通过二进制动态口罩监督的图像合成,在不进行密集几何或运动监督的情况下,通过对隐形视图-时间对等的取样来学习这种分解.

blocks.en: We evaluate our approach on synthetic and real datasets under a systematic protocol. To effectively demonstrate the performance of 4D novel view synthesis and the capability of view-time disentanglement, we separate the setting with novel view synthesis, cross-time view synthesis, and novel time synthesis. FL4N achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across datasets in the pose-free setting without test-time pose optimization, while optionally incorporating context camera poses further enables state-of-the-art performance across all three settings.
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们根据系统议定书对合成和真实数据集采取的方法。 为了有效展示4D小说取景合成的性能和取景时间分解的能力,我们用取景新作取景合成,跨时取景合成,取景新作取景时间分解. FL4N在没有测试时间的情况下在平面设置中实现最先进的或竞争性的跨数据集性能优化,而可选地收录上下文相机则进一步使得所有三种设置都能够实现最先进的性能.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • First 4D latent NVS model. We present to jointly model 3D structure and temporal variation in a latent space, rendering novel views at novel timestamps without explicit 3D representations or target-view/time observations. • A residual formulation for efficient dynamic adaptation. We formulate 4D NVS as learning a temporal residual on a frozen static representation. This leverages the pretrained scene and viewpoint priors while concentrating learning on temporal variation through a lightweight branch. • State-of-the-art performance. We comprehensively benchmark 4D NVS across novel view, cross-time, and novel time synthesis on eight synthetic and real-world benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art rendering quality on all three settings, with the fastest runtime.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下: 第一个4D潜在NVS模型。 我们提出在潜在空间共同模拟三维结构和时间变化,在新的时间戳上发表新观点,但没有明确的三维表述或目标-观点/时间观察。 二. 支助 用于高效动态适应的剩余配方。 我们制定了4D NVS 以学习在被冻结的静态代表物上的时间残余。 这利用了事先训练过的场景和视角前作,同时通过轻量级分支集中学习时间变化. • 最新业绩。 我们全面的基准 4D NVS 跨越了新颖的视野,跨时空, 和新奇的时间合成 8 个合成和现实世界的基准, 实现最先进的渲染质量 在所有三种设置, 运行时间最快。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Feed-forward Gaussian splatting for 4D novel view synthesis. Explicit feed-forward 4D methods typically represent scenes with 3D Gaussians extended with temporal dynamics, such as velocity ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) or deformation fields ( Lin et al., 2026a ; Lin et al., 2026b ) .
However, independently modeling motion per Gaussian often disrupts object rigidity and temporal consistency due to incoherent motion among nearby Gaussians ( Kim et al., 2026c ) , yielding artifacts such as temporal ghosting.
Anchoring Gaussian prediction to each target timestamp ( Liang et al., 2025 ) can sidestep the issue but is susceptible to view bias by primarily relying on nearby frames while underutilizing observation from distant frames.
Query-based Gaussian representation ( Kim et al., 2026c ) alleviates this via dense motion supervision, yet its limited number of queries constrains rendering quality due to insufficient Gaussian coverage, particularly for large outdoor scenes.
Multi-view approaches ( Balice et al., 2026 ) can exploit observations from multiple time-synchronized static cameras, but the setup is far more restrictive than a monocular moving camera.
We introduce a feed-forward latent-based method with minimal geometric inductive bias in a practical but more challenging monocular camera setup.
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward Gaussian splateting 为4D小说取景合成. 明确饲料向上4D方法一般代表有时间动态延伸的3D高斯人场景,如速度(徐等,2025;杨等,2026)或变形场(林等,2026a; Lin等, 2026b. (中文(简体) ).
然而,由于附近的高斯人之间运动不连贯(Kim等,2026c),独立建模运动(per Gaussian)经常会打乱物体的刚性和时间一致性,产生时间幽灵等文物.
对每个目标时间戳(Liang等,2025年)的安打高斯预测可以回避这个问题,但可以通过主要依靠相邻的帧来观察偏差,同时对从相距遥远的帧的观测利用不足.
基于查询的高斯人代表 (Kim等, 2026c.)通过密集的运动监督来缓解这种情况,然而由于高斯的覆盖面不足,特别是大型室外场景,其有限的查询数量限制了制作质量.
多取景方法(Balice等,2026年)可以从多台时间同步静态相机中利用观测,但设置比单相机移动相机更具限制性.
我们在实用但更具挑战性的单相机布局中,引入了一种以几何导体最小偏差为基础的向导潜在方法。

blocks.en:
Latent-based novel view synthesis. Latent-based NVS models synthesize novel views with transformers conditioned on the target pose ( Sajjadi et al., 2022 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Jin et al., 2025 ; Szymanowicz et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026a ) or latent pose variable ( Mitchel et al., 2025 ) , bypassing explicit 3D representations.
Although RayDer ( Prestel et al., 2026 ) trains on dynamic videos, it still targets static NVS while suppressing object motion via per-view nuisance token that is dropped at inference.
Despite their strong generalization, these methods either assume static scenes or treat dynamic content as variation to be ignored rather than modeled.
Toward dynamic latent representations, DyST ( Seitzer et al., 2024 ) extends RUST ( Sajjadi et al., 2023 ) with a dynamics estimator, yet keeps its scene latent time-invariant.
Temporal variation is decoded via control codes extracted from target-pose and target-time frames, which limits explicit view and time control and risks appearance leakage from these frames.
In contrast, our model constructs a time-conditioned scene latent that is rendered from arbitrary
target cameras, enabling synthesis at novel views and novel timestamps.
blocks.zh:
以Latent为主的小说取景综合. 基于Latent的NVS模型合成了以目标姿势为条件的变压器的新观点(Sajjadi等,2022年;Jiang等,2025年;Jin等,2025年;Szymanowicz等,2026年;Kim等,2026年a)或潜在姿势可变(Mitchel等,2025年),绕过明确的3D表示.
虽然RayDer(Prestel等,2026年)在动态视频上进行列车,但它仍然以静态NVS为目标,同时通过推想中投放的每景扰动符来压制物体运动.
尽管这些方法具有很强的通俗性,但要么假设静态场景,要么将动态内容视为可被忽略的变异,而不是被建模.
DyST(Seitzer等人,2024年)将RUST(Sajjadi等人,2023年)扩展为动态潜在表示,但保持其场景潜在的时间变化。
时间变化是通过从目标拥有地和目标时间框架提取的控制代码解码的,这限制了清晰的视野和时间控制以及这些框架的外观泄漏的风险.
反之,我们的模型 构建了一个有时间条件的场景 潜在的 由任意
目标相机,允许在新视角和新时间戳进行合成.

blocks.en:
Generative novel view synthesis. NVS becomes inherently ambiguous when target views extend into regions unseen in the input views. Deterministic methods maintain strong cross-view consistency on observed content but tend to blur unobserved regions ( Prestel et al., 2026 ; Szymanowicz et al., 2026 ) .
Generative approaches ( Van Hoorick et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) can extrapolate plausible content beyond the observed regions, yet their stochastic sampling often compromises cross-view consistency and scene faithfulness ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026c ) .
Although generative refinement can post-process rendered views from Gaussian representations ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026c ) or serve as a diffusion decoder for latent-based model ( Szymanowicz et al., 2026 ) , our work focuses on deterministic NVS and remains orthogonal to such generative refinement directions.
blocks.zh:
基因小说取景综合. 当目标观点延伸到投入观点所未见的区域时,NVS本身就变得模糊不清. 定型方法在被观测到的内容上保持了强烈的交叉视图一致性,但往往模糊了未观测到的区域(Prestel等,2026;Szymanowicz等,2026.).
遗传性办法 (Van Hoorick等人,2024年;Bai等人,2025年;Yu等人,2025年;Ren等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年)可以推断出观测区域以外的可信内容,然而,他们的花样取样往往会损害交叉观点的一致性和场景的忠实性(Jin等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026年c.).
虽然基因改进可以后处理从高斯表达(Yang等,2026;Kim等,2026c)或作为潜在模型(Szymanowicz等,2026)的传播解码器,但我们的工作侧重于确定性NVS,并且对于这种基因改进方向仍然具有正统性。

In the following, we first review the latent static NVS baseline that forms a basis of our method (§ 3.1 ).
We then introduce FL4N, describing the technical details on the dynamic encoder with target-time residual adaptation (§ 3.2 ).
Finally, we detail the training strategy (§ 3.3 ) and conclude by analyzing the learned residual features (§ 3.4 ).

在下文中,我们首先审查构成我们方法基础的潜在静态NVS基线(第3.1节)。
然后,我们介绍FL4N,描述带有目标时间剩余适应的动态编码器的技术细节(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: Latent-based static NVS methods ( Szymanowicz et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) encode multi-view images of a static scene into a latent scene representation and synthesize a novel view by decoding this latent conditioned on a target camera pose. Such a framework comprises a multi-view encoder ℰ st \mathcal{E}_{\text{st}} and a renderer ℛ \mathcal{R} . Camera parameters are optional, conditioning the encoder when available and otherwise letting the model operate pose-free.

blocks.en:
Dynamic encoder. To learn to disentangle dynamic motion from static scene structure in monocular videos, we freeze the pretrained static encoder ℰ st \mathcal{E}_{\text{st}} and renderer ℛ \mathcal{R} , and introduce a lightweight dynamic encoder ℰ dyn \mathcal{E}_{\text{dyn}} .
The static encoder ℰ st \mathcal{E}_{\text{st}} already captures time-invariant content and camera-induced viewpoint changes from its static-scene training.
During our dynamic-scene training, the frozen static encoder and renderer allow the dynamic encoder ℰ dyn \mathcal{E}_{\text{dyn}} to learn temporal variations as residuals to the pretrained static representation.
Freezing the renderer ℛ \mathcal{R} fixes latent-to-image mapping, forcing the residual feature to the pretrained latent space. This encourages them to complement the static representation rather than learn a new feature space from limited dynamic data.

Having no target-time input, the static latent 𝐳 st \mathbf{z}_{\text{st}} compresses the video sequence into a single time-invariant prediction; moving content is thus discarded or frozen at observed frames with the input pose entangled, as in Fig. 3 .
Our residual latent 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} supplies this missing temporal axis.
Conditioned on the target time, it complements the static latent with time-dependent variation, placing the dynamic object at its target-time position while preserving the static background.

blocks.en: Residual feature encodes temporal dynamics. Figure 4 compares the static latent 𝐳 st \mathbf{z}_{\text{st}} and residual latent 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} using PCA visualization. While the static latent exhibits camera-ray-like patterns, the residual latent suppresses static regions and captures distinct motion across time, suggesting that the dynamic encoder effectively isolates temporal variation from the time-invariant scene representation.

blocks.en: Implementation details. Our model builds on a frozen static novel view synthesizer ( Szymanowicz et al., 2026 ) , with only the dynamic encoder, time module, and mask head trained. The dynamic encoder follows the architecture of the pretrained static encoder, with added cross-attention module for each layer but uses one-third of its depth, with 8 transformer layers compared to 24 in the static encoder, since temporal variation accounts for only a relatively small portion of the scene. Further architectural and training details are provided in Appendix A .

Unlike costly, explicit 3D annotation ( e. g . , dense depth or 3D motion) that is commonly used for 3D-Gaussian-based approaches, the multi-view datasets provide cost-effective indirect 4D supervision from 2D images.
Furthermore, our residual formulation specifically makes this RGB-only supervision directly tractable, with requiring relatively small amount as well.

Evaluation setting. We evaluate three settings, novel view synthesis (NVS), cross-time view synthesis (CTVS), and novel time synthesis (NTS), illustrated in Fig. 6 .
NVS evaluates held-out viewpoints at input timestamps, CTVS evaluates unseen viewpoints-timestamps combinations from a monocular video, and NTS evaluates intermediate timestamps from temporally strided inputs.
NVS and CTVS use multi-view datasets from fixed cameras: NVIDIA ( Yoon et al., 2020 ) , N3DV ( Li et al., 2022 ) , Kubric4D, CamxTime, and Charge ( Nazarczuk et al., 2026 ) .
NTS is evaluated on monocular videos captured by moving cameras: DyCheck ( Gao et al., 2022 ) , ADT ( Pan et al., 2023 ) , and TUM ( Sturm et al., 2012 ) .
Kubric4D and CamxTime are evaluated on held-out test scenes from our training distribution, whereas the other datasets evaluate zero-shot generalization. Detailed evaluation protocol is provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en:
Quantitative results. Tables 1 , 2 , and 3 report the three protocols. Here, † denotes 2,000-step test-time pose alignment with target frames, and Pose (✓/✗) indicates context pose input.
FL4N achieves state-of-the-art performance among all pose-free baselines, even without test-time alignment, except for SSIM on NVS of two real-world datasets.
On real-world datasets, whose camera poses are noisy estimates, C4G benefits from test-time pose alignment while our model is forced to estimate slight inaccurate pose relation, resulting in a slight misalignment of pixels.
An optional incorporation of context camera poses further improves the accuracy by exploiting the explicit context-to-target pose relation achieving state-of-the-art performance across all benchmarks on all protocols.
These results demonstrate the substantial strength of our proposed latent representation: strong 4D prior, generalization to novel view and time, and decouplement of view and time, all successfully learned in the latent space.
Additional rendering quality evaluation on dynamic region and discussion on test-time pose alignment are provided in Appendices D.1 and F .

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced FL4N, a feed-forward latent model that renders dynamic scenes from a monocular video at novel views and timestamps.
By learning a temporal residual on top of a frozen static latent model, FL4N acquires a 4D representation from limited dynamic data, supervised only by images and binary dynamic masks.
Across eight benchmarks and three evaluation protocols, FL4N outperforms prior feed-forward Gaussian-based methods and generalizes to real-world videos, while its latent space successfully disentangles view from time and preserves scene geometry.
Our work demonstrates the potential of latent representations for feed-forward 4D novel view synthesis, opening new directions for latent-based 4D scene understanding and modeling more complex dynamics.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了FL4N,这是一种向上提供素材的潜伏模型,在新颖的视角和时间戳上使单相机视频的动态场景产生.
FL4N通过在被冷冻的静态潜入模型上学习出一个时间残存,从有限的动态数据中获取了4D代表,仅由图像和二进制活性口罩监督.
FL4N在8个基准和3个评价协议中,超越了先前的以Gaussian为基础的方法,并概括到现实世界的视频,而其潜在的空间则成功地从时间上分散了视野并保存了场景几何.
我们的工作表明,潜在的表述有可能促进向上4D小说视图的合成,为潜在的4D场景理解开辟了新的方向并模拟更复杂的动态。

blocks.en: A.1 Architecture details
blocks.zh: A.1 建筑细节

blocks.en:
Static encoder and renderer. The static prior used is a pretrained feed-forward novel view synthesizer whose encoder is a 24 24 -layer transformer alternating frame-wise and global attention, followed by a 12 12 -layer transformer renderer.
Both use a hidden size of 768 768 with 12 12 heads on 8 × 8 8\times 8 patches, and remain frozen during our training.
blocks.zh:
静态编码器和渲染器 先前使用的静态是经过预先训练的向导小说取景合成器,其编码器为24个24层变压器,相继是12个12层变压器的渲染器.
两者都使用768 768的隐形尺寸,并有12个头在8×8相8相8相8相接的补丁上,并在我们训练期间保持被冻结.

blocks.en: Dynamic encoder. The dynamic encoder adopts the same core architecture as the static encoder, augmented with cross-attention, but uses one-third of its depth, with 8 8 layers. It is initialized with weights uniformly sampled from the pretrained static encoder. Each layer additionally cross-attends to the last layer of static features, allowing the residual branch to access camera-pose-aware representations throughout encoding. This provides a spatial anchor for learning motion residuals, complementing the static features rather than relearning scene structure. A DPT decoder ( Ranftl et al., 2021 ) attached to the dynamic encoder predicts the binary dynamic mask.
blocks.zh: 动态编码器. 活性编码器采用与静性编码器相同的核心架构,并用交叉意向来扩充,但使用其深度的三分之一,有8个8层. 其初始化时,从预先训练的静态编码器中统一取样出重量。 每层外加相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相相接相 这为学习运动后遗症提供了空间锚地,补充了静态特征而不是再学习场景结构. 动态编码器所附带的DPT解码器(Ranftl等,2021年)预言二进制动态口罩.

blocks.en:
Temporal conditioning. We use a single learnable time token 𝝉 ∈ ℝ C \bm{\tau}\in\mathbb{R}^{C} with C = 1024 C=1024 , and attach a copy of it to each input view by concatenating it with that view’s tokens.
Each copy becomes view-specific ( 𝝉 ^ k \hat{\bm{\tau}}_{k} ) through attention with its own view, allowing the same token to handle an arbitrary number and ordering of context frames. The resulting time representation is processed by a time module consisting of two transformer blocks with adaptive layer normalization conditioned on the target-time token, followed by a zero-initialized linear residual gate.
blocks.zh:
时间调节。 我们使用一个单一的可学习的时间符\\R C\bm\tau\in\mathb{R\C}与C=1024 C=1024,并通过将它与该视图的符文相配合,在每一个输入视图中附上一份副本。
每份副本都通过自己视图的注意而成为特定视图(\\ k\ bm\ tau\ k}),允许同一字节处理任意的上下文框编号和顺序. 由此产生的时间表示由一个时间模块处理,该模块由两个变压器块组成,其适应层正常化以目标时间符号为条件,然后是零初始线性剩余闸门。

blocks.en: A.2 Training details
blocks.zh: A.2 培训详情

blocks.en: Training setup. We train with AdamW at a learning rate of 3.5 × 10 − 5 3.5\times 10^{-5} , weight decay 0.05 0.05 , and 3 3 k warmup steps, while keeping the static encoder and renderer frozen for whole training. FL4N is trained on four NVIDIA RTX 5880 Ada Generation GPUs with a batch size of 8 for total of 32k steps. Each training sample contains 8 conditioning views and 12 target views at a resolution of 336 × 512 336\times 512 .
blocks.zh: 培训设置. 我们用 AdamW 的学习速度为 3.5 × 10 − 5 3.5\ Times 10 × 5 × 5 , 重量衰减 0.05 0.05 和 3 个 3 千 个暖和步骤,同时 保持静态编码器和渲染器 被冻结用于整个训练. FL4N在四台NVIDIA RTX 5880 Ada Center GPU上接受训练,分批大小为8个,共32k级. 每个培训样本包含8个条件视图和12个目标视图,分辨率为336×512 336\times 512.

blocks.en: Training datasets. We use Kubric4D ( Van Hoorick et al., 2024 ) and CamxTime ( Huang et al., 2026 ) , which provide synchronized multi-view videos captured by static cameras. To disentangle camera and object motion, we train the model to reconstruct target frames at view–time pairs not included in the input set.
blocks.zh: 培训数据集。 我们使用Kubric4D(Van Hoorick等,2024年)和CamxTime(Huang等,2026年),它们提供由静态相机所捕获的同步多景视频. 为了分辨相机和物体运动,我们训练模型在未包含在输入集中的查看-时间对等时重建目标帧.

blocks.en: Pose dropout. To support pose-free conditioning at inference, we randomly zero out the conditioning camera tokens with probability 0.4 0.4 during training. At inference time, FL4N supports fully unposed setting by zeroing all conditioning camera tokens.
blocks.zh: Pose辍学。 为了在推论中支持无姿势的调制,我们随机地将调制相机的相机信号以0.4 0.4的概率淘汰出. 在推论时间,FL4N支持通过将所有调取相机的相机符号零化来完全不设位设置.

blocks.en: Loss. We use an ℓ 2 \ell_{2} photometric loss ℒ 2 \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{2}} , LPIPS losses ℒ perc \mathcal{L}_{\text{perc}} and ℒ perc dyn \mathcal{L}_{\text{perc}}^{\text{dyn}} , and an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} image-gradient loss ℒ grad dyn \mathcal{L}_{\text{grad}}^{\text{dyn}} . The dynamic-region losses are computed using the dynamic mask M k M_{k} to select moving pixels, on 128 × 128 128\times 128 crops centered on the moving content. For the image loss term, the dynamic and static regions are averaged over their respective areas and weighted equally. Dynamic mask loss is only comptued for context frames. We set λ perc = 0.5 \lambda_{\text{perc}}=0.5 , λ perc dyn = 2.0 \lambda_{\text{perc}}^{\text{dyn}}=2.0 , λ grad dyn = 1.0 \lambda_{\text{grad}}^{\text{dyn}}=1.0 , and λ mask = 1.0 \lambda_{\text{mask}}=1.0 .

blocks.en: Pseudo dynamic mask generation. We generate pseudo dynamic masks by thresholding the magnitude of optical flow estimated by an off-the-shelf flow estimator ( Wang and Deng, 2026 ) . Since the flow is computed between frames captured by the same static camera, camera-induced motion and parallax are absent, making the remaining flow primarily reflect object motion. This leverages the static-camera multi-view configuration of our training data to identify dynamic regions with binary pseudo labels. The mask generation can also be easily replaced with off-the-shelf segmentation models, such as SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2025 ) , without changing the training framework.
blocks.zh: Pseudo动态口罩生成. 我们通过将现成的流量估计器(王和邓,2026年)估计的光学流量阈值来产生伪活性口罩. 由于流由同一台静相相机所捕获的相框之间计算出,相相机所引发的相机运动和等 Parallax不存在,使所剩相机流主要反映物体运动. 这利用了我们培训数据的静态-相机多视图配置,以识别具有二元伪标签的动态区域. 口罩的生成也可以轻易地被现成的分化模型所取代,如SAM3(Carion等,2025年),而无需改变训练框架.

blocks.en: B.1 Evaluation datasets

blocks.en: Our benchmark comprises five multi-view datasets for NVS and CTVS: NVIDIA, N3DV, Kubric4D, CamxTime, and Charge, and three datasets for NTS: ADT, DyCheck, and TUM. Kubric4D and CamxTime use held-out scenes, while the remaining datasets are unseen during training and evaluate cross-dataset generalization.
blocks.zh: 我们的基准包括NVS和CTVS的五个多视图数据集:NVIDIA、N3DV、Kubric4D、CamxTime和Charge,以及NTS的三个数据集:ADT、Dycheck和TUM。 Kubric4D和CamxTime使用被搁置的场景,而其余的数据集则是在培训和评价跨数据集通论时所看不到的.

blocks.en: For static camera multi-view datasets, we simulate moving camera monocular video by selecting N diagonal frames, i. e . camera i i observed at time i i as input.

blocks.en: Kubric4D. We use 100 test scenes from Kubric4D, which contains 16 static cameras, with the first four providing top-down views and the remaining 12 cameras arranged around the scene on a horizontal ring. Each camera captures 60 frames. We exclude the first four cameras and sample cameras consecutively from the horizontal ring. We use a frame interval of 8.

blocks.en: CamxTime. CamxTime contains four separate camera trajectories, each comprising 120 densely spaced cameras with 120 frames per camera. We hold out the last 10% of scenes for testing and use Trajectory_01 for evaluation, with camera and frame intervals both set to 8.

blocks.en: B.3 Model specific configurations
blocks.zh: B.3 模式具体配置

blocks.en: Every model runs at the native input resolution. For the pose-free baselines, NeoVerse ( Yang et al., 2026 ) and C4G ( Kim et al., 2026c ) , we apply 2,000 steps of test-time pose alignment ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, FL4N does not perform pose alignment, despite being evaluated in the pose-free setting. For real-world datasets, FL4N uses camera poses predicted by VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , using the estimated intrinsics for NVIDIA and the estimated intrinsics and extrinsics for N3DV.
blocks.zh: 每个模型运行在本地输入分辨率. 对于无姿势基线,NeoVerse(Yang等,2026年)和C4G(Kim等,2026年c.),我们采用2000个步骤的测试时间构成对等(Ye等,2025年). 相形之下,FL4N不进行外形对齐,尽管在无外形的环境下受到评价. 对于现实世界的数据集,FL4N使用由VGGT(Wang等,2025a)预测的相机外形,使用NVIDIA的估计内在成分和N3DV的估计内在成分和外在成分.

blocks.en: D.2 Additional analysis on quantitative results
blocks.zh: D.2 对定量结果的进一步分析

blocks.en: In the main table, NeoVerse performs notably poorly on Kubric4D. This is because NeoVerse tends to provide weaker information across the temporal axis and produces many holes, leaving regions unseen at a given timestamp largely unmodeled. This issue is particularly severe on Kubric4D, where the large camera gaps span nearly the entire viewing range, making regions observed at different timestamps, such as the background, especially difficult to reconstruct.

We first compare against the static NVS backbone and its fine-tuned variant. While both provide a strong static-scene prior, fine-tuning alone does not effectively capture scene dynamics.
We further ablate architectural choices. Unfreezing the renderer degrades performance, suggesting that preserving the pretrained latent-to-image mapping is beneficial. The single-branch encoder, removal of the dynamic mask loss, and sinusoidal time embeddings all underperform our full model. blocks.en: Appendix F Test-time pose alignment for latent models
blocks.zh: 附录F 试验时间对潜在模型的调整

blocks.en: Evaluating models that do not receive conditioning poses can introduce scale misalignment with the ground truth, resulting in poor rendering metrics even when the predicted scene is geometrically accurate. Since the input images do not determine an absolute scale, a pose-free model may reconstruct the scene at an arbitrary scale. Pose-free methods therefore perform test-time pose alignment before evaluation and report rendering metrics using the aligned poses ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026c ) . This alignment only brings the prediction into the coordinate frame and scale of the ground truth without modifying the underlying scene content.
blocks.zh: 评价那些不接受调制的模型可能会引入与地表真理的尺度错配,导致渲染度量度差,即使预测的场景是几何精确的. 由于输入图像不能确定绝对尺度,因此无姿势模型可以任意尺度地重建场景. 因此,无松药方法在使用对齐的外观进行评价和报告度量度之前进行测试,形成一致(Ye等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026年c.)。 这种对接只会将预测带入地表真理的坐标框架和尺度,而不会修改基本的场景内容.

blocks.en: The pose-free Gaussian baselines in our quantitative comparisons are evaluated with 2,000 step pose-alignment steps, whereas FL4N is reported without pose alignment in the main tables. However, FL4N is also pose-free and therefore suffers from the same scale ambiguity that motivates this evaluation procedure. We thus additionally evaluate FL4N with the same 2,000 step pose alignment to provide a consistent comparison.
blocks.zh: 在我们的定量比较中,用2000个步骤来评价不设姿势的高斯基线,而FL4N则在主要表格中报告不设姿势。 然而,新FL4N也是不设姿势的,因此面临同样规模的模糊性,促使这一评估程序。 因此,我们用同样的2 000个步骤对新军进行额外评估,以提供一致的比较。

blocks.en: For Gaussian models, Gaussians are predicted once from the conditioning images and kept fixed throughout the alignment process. Differentiable rasterization allows the rendering loss to be backpropagated to the camera pose, so each alignment step re-rasterizes the same frozen Gaussians under an updated pose, without modifying the network or scene representation.
blocks.zh: 对于高斯模型来说,高斯人从调节图像中一次被预测,并在整个对齐过程中保持固定. 可分辨的光栅化使得渲染损失被反向地传播到相机外形上,因此每个对接步骤都会在更新后外形下再对同一种被冻结的高斯人进行渲染,而无需修改网络或场景表现.

blocks.en: The analogous procedure can be done to our latent renderer. The scene latent is predicted solely from the conditioning images and is independent of the rendering process. We therefore compute the latent once and keep it fixed throughout the alignment process, with the renderer serving the role of rasterization by re-rendering the cached latent under an updated target pose at each step. For both Gaussian and latent models, we optimize a rotation and translation offset for each target pose ( Ye et al., 2025 ) , initialized at zero such that the initial rendering exactly matches the feed-forward prediction. We use the same objective as the Gaussian baselines, with 2,000 Adam steps using pixel and perceptual losses. Table G reports the effect of this alignment under the NTS protocol on ADT and TUM. Alignment is worth 5.94 5.94 dB to C4G on ADT and 5.13 5.13 dB on TUM, against 3.59 3.59 dB and 2.55 2.55 dB for our model, so a large part of the published margin of C4G on these cells comes from fitting the pose to the image it is then scored on. How much alignment recovers therefore measures how much error the supplied cameras carry rather than the quality of the reconstruction, and our model without any alignment remains ahead of both aligned baselines on every metric.
blocks.zh: 类似的程序可以对我们的潜在渲染器进行。 场景潜伏的预想完全来自调制图像,独立于渲染过程. 因此,我们计算潜在值一次,并在整个调整过程中保持固定,由渲染器发挥光栅化作用,在更新的目标下重新提供缓存的潜在值,在每一步骤都起到作用。 对于高斯和潜在模型,我们优化了每个目标姿势的旋转和翻译相抵(Ye等人,2025年),初始化为零,使初始渲染完全符合向导预测。 我们使用与高斯基线相同的目标,2000个亚当步骤使用像素和感官损失. 页:1 G报告了NTS协议下这种调整对ADT和TUM的影响. 对齐值为ADT上的5.94 5.94分贝对C4G,TUM上的5.13 5.13分贝对等值,而我们的型号为3.59 3.59分贝和2.55 2.55分贝对等值,因此这些细胞上C4G的已公布比值有很大一部分来自将外观配上被打入的图像. 因此,调整恢复了多少,衡量了所供应的相机有多少错误,而不是重建的质量。 我们的模型没有作出任何调整,仍然领先于每个衡量标准上的两个统一基线。

blocks.en: Appendix G Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录G 限制

blocks.en: Our approach inherits the limitations of the pretrained static latent NVS backbone, particularly when rendering from extrapolated viewpoints that are unseen in the input views. Latent NVS models cannot synthesize unseen content ( Jin et al., 2025 ) , resulting in blurry or collapsed renderings under extrapolation, as also observed in ( Szymanowicz et al., 2026 ) . In contrast, explicit Gaussian representations construct scene content in 3D space, allowing the observed portions of the scene to remain usable even when extrapolation leaves holes in unseen regions.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法继承了预先训练的静态潜伏NVS主干线的局限性,特别是在从输入视图所未见的推导出观点时。 Latentnt NVS模型无法合成隐形内容(Jin等,2025年),导致外推下出现模糊或倒塌的渲染,也见于(Szymanowicz等,2026年). 相形之下,明确的高斯表示在3D空间构建出场景内容,即使外推在看不见的区域留下出洞,现场被观察到的部分仍然可以使用.

blocks.en: The residual formulation can compensate for certain errors in the static prediction, but its capacity is naturally limited when the underlying scene representation or camera pose is substantially incorrect. These limitations can be alleviated by using stronger static NVS models with broader scene coverage and more robust viewpoint understanding.
blocks.zh: 剩余配方可以补偿静态预测中的某些错误,但当基础场景表现或相机所呈现的高度不正确时,其能力自然受到限制. 这些局限性可以通过使用更强大的静态NVS模型来缓解,这些模型具有更广泛的场景覆盖面和更强的视角理解.
